recs.name: Campagnola
recs.shortDescription: A longtime Evanston favorite for seasonal, farm-to-table Italian cooking in a warm, brick-walled dining room. Great for a special dinner or celebrating an occasion just a few blocks from campus.

recs.name: Backlot Coffee
recs.shortDescription: An independently owned Evanston coffeehouse with a loyal following — great pastries, friendly baristas, and a laid-back community feel. A favorite among both locals and Northwestern students.

recs.name: Ward Eight
recs.shortDescription: A cozy, unpretentious cocktail lounge with expertly crafted drinks and a relaxed vibe. Consistently ranked among Evanston's best bars for guests who want a proper cocktail without the fuss.

recs.name: Clark Street Beach & Lighthouse
recs.shortDescription: The closest public beach to downtown Evanston, with soft sand, lake views, and the iconic Evanston Lighthouse nearby. A great spot for a morning walk or sunset visit.

recs.name: Bookends & Beginnings
recs.shortDescription: A beloved two-story independent bookstore in the heart of downtown Evanston, with new and used books, gifts, literary events, and a cozy in-store bar. A must for book-loving guests — and it's practically next door to the hotel.

recs.name: Block Museum of Art
recs.shortDescription: Northwestern's public art museum, free and open to all, with a global exhibition program spanning eras and cultures. An easy, no-cost cultural stop for guests exploring campus.

recs.name: Koi Fine Asian Cuisine & Lounge
recs.shortDescription: Stylish pan-Asian restaurant and lounge with sushi, a full Asian-fusion menu, and a fireplace patio that guests love in the evenings. Good for a dinner that feels a bit more elevated.

recs.name: Reprise Coffee Roasters
recs.shortDescription: Evanston's specialty coffee roaster, known for its award-winning lattes and calm, rustic atmosphere. A great stop for guests who take their coffee seriously.

recs.name: Temperance Beer Company
recs.shortDescription: Evanston's first and oldest brewery, pouring house-made IPAs and seasonal beers in a lively taproom. Hosts brewery tours and events, making it a fun stop for beer-curious guests.

recs.name: Dawes Park & Arrington Lagoon
recs.shortDescription: A scenic lakefront park with a lagoon, walking paths, and a pier — home to ducks, geese, and one of Evanston's most photogenic outdoor spots. Turns into an ice rink in winter.

recs.name: Kabul House
recs.shortDescription: Authentic Afghan cuisine in a warm, welcoming setting — think kabobs, mantu dumplings, and fragrant rice dishes. A great pick for guests looking for something they can't easily find elsewhere.

recs.name: Tapas Barcelona
recs.shortDescription: Lively Spanish tapas spot perfect for groups who want to share small plates and sangria. Popular for its energetic weekend atmosphere and flamenco nights.

recs.name: Blue Horse Tavern
recs.shortDescription: No-frills neighborhood tavern known for a deep bourbon and whiskey list alongside solid American comfort food — burgers, ribs, and hearty pub fare. A reliable, unpretentious go-to.

recs.name: Union Squared
recs.shortDescription: Square-cut, Detroit-style pizza piled high with toppings like Mike's hot honey and pickled jalapeños. Quick, affordable, and popular with the Northwestern crowd — outdoor terrace seating in nice weather.

recs.name: Frida's Breakfast & Lunch
recs.shortDescription: A cozy, no-fuss breakfast-and-lunch spot for guests who want a great morning meal before heading out for the day. Known for generous portions and friendly service.

recs.name: Soul & Smoke
recs.shortDescription: Serious, competition-style barbecue with smoked brisket, ribs, and all the classic sides. A great casual option for guests craving something hearty and Southern-inspired.

recs.name: Habibi Mediterranean Grill
recs.shortDescription: Fresh, flavorful Mediterranean grill fare — shawarma, falafel, hummus plates — in a casual, fast-friendly setting. A dependable lighter option near downtown Evanston.

recs.name: Taco Diablo
recs.shortDescription: A local go-to for tacos and margaritas in a fun, colorful space. Frequently mentioned alongside Evanston's other neighborhood favorites as a reliable casual dinner spot.

recs.name: Brothers K Coffeehouse
recs.shortDescription: A mellow, well-loved coffeehouse with a cozy diner-esque feel, serving coffee from around the world plus teas, smoothies, and pastries. Great for settling in with a book or laptop.

recs.name: Cupitol Coffee & Eatery
recs.shortDescription: A bright, spacious café serving lattes, croissants, and a full food menu — equally good for a quick coffee or a longer brunch sit-down.

recs.name: Sketchbook Brewing Evanston
recs.shortDescription: A intimate brewery outpost with a dozen beers on tap and an easy-to-reach location near transit. Good for a casual group hangout after a day of exploring.

recs.name: Five & Dime
recs.shortDescription: A go-to for casual dinners and drinks, with one of Evanston's best rooftop patios for warm-weather evenings. Known for shareable American fare and a relaxed, fun atmosphere.

recs.name: Northwestern Campus & Shakespeare Garden
recs.shortDescription: Northwestern's lakefront campus is worth a stroll on its own, and the Shakespeare Garden — planted with flora referenced in the Bard's works — is a hidden, quiet gem for literature-minded guests.

recs.name: Ladd Arboretum
recs.shortDescription: A peaceful stretch of green space along the North Shore Channel, popular for walking, jogging, and birdwatching. A nice escape from downtown Evanston's bustle.

recs.name: Amaranth Books
recs.shortDescription: A 30-plus-year Evanston institution for used and rare books, plus classical music CDs and DVDs. Great for guests who love browsing for something unexpected.

recs.name: Evanston SPACE
recs.shortDescription: A beloved, intimate live music venue hosting touring and local acts across genres. A great option for guests looking for something to do in the evening beyond dinner.

recs.name: Millennium Park & The Bean
recs.shortDescription: Home to Cloud Gate (aka 'The Bean'), Crown Fountain, and the Pritzker Pavilion — one of Chicago's most iconic and unmissable free attractions, about 30 minutes from Evanston.

recs.name: Chicago Riverwalk
recs.shortDescription: A 1.25-mile riverfront path lined with bars, restaurants, and boat tour docks, with great views of the city's famous architecture. Ideal for an afternoon or evening downtown.

recs.name: Art Institute of Chicago
recs.shortDescription: One of the world's premier art museums, with an outstanding Impressionist and modern art collection alongside the iconic lion statues out front. Worth a half-day for art-loving guests.

recs.name: Gibsons Italia
recs.shortDescription: A polished River North Italian spot with sweeping Chicago River and skyline views — a strong pick for guests wanting an upscale dinner while in the city for the day.
